def get(u,p):

def parse_pdb(p):
    A=[]
    for l in open(p):
        if l.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
            try: xyz=[float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]
            except ValueError: continue
            if (l[76:78].strip() or "C")=="H": continue
            A.append(dict(name=l[12:16].strip(),alt=l[16],resn=l[17:20].strip(),chain=l[21],
                          resi=int(l[22:26]),xyz=np.array(xyz),b=float(l[60:66] or 0)))
    return A

# quantify the KxGQ domain displacement between apo 4PED and nucleotide-bound 5I35

    return d

def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc); U,Sv,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    D=np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))]); R=Vt.T@D@U.T; return R,qc-R@pc

P=np.array([d5[r] for r in core]); Q=np.array([d4[r] for r in core])
R,t=kabsch(P,Q); rms_core=np.sqrt((np.linalg.norm((R@P.T).T+t-Q,axis=1)**2).mean())
Pk=np.array([d5[r] for r in kx]); Qk=np.array([d4[r] for r in kx])
dev=np.linalg.norm((R@Pk.T).T+t-Qk,axis=1)
print("\n4PED(apo) vs 5I35(AMP-PNP), superposed on the kinase core only (res 320-644, n=%d): core RMSD %.2f A"%(len(core),rms_core))
print("KxGQ domain (res 258-310, n=%d) displacement after that fit: mean %.2f A, max %.2f A"%(len(kx),dev.mean(),dev.max()))
i279=kx.index(279) if 279 in kx else None

def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2)
    s1i=np.array([ai.get(c,22) for c in s1]); s2i=np.array([ai.get(c,22) for c in s2])
    NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); X=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Y=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    M[0,0]=0; X[1:,0]=go+ge*np.arange(n); Y[0,1:]=go+ge*np.arange(m)
    jj=np.arange(m+1); ar=np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        sc=M62[s1i[i-1],s2i]
        prev=np.maximum.reduce([M[i-1,:-1],X[i-1,:-1],Y[i-1,:-1]])
        M[i,1:]=prev+sc
        pM[i,1:]=np.argmax(np.vstack([M[i-1,:-1],X[i-1,:-1],Y[i-1,:-1]]),axis=0)
        a=np.maximum(M[i-1],Y[i-1])+go; b=X[i-1]+ge
        X[i]=np.maximum(a,b); pX[i]=np.where(a>=b,np.where(M[i-1]>=Y[i-1],0,2),1)
        v=np.maximum(M[i],X[i])+go-ge*jj
        cm=np.maximum.accumulate(v[:m]); am=np.maximum.accumulate(np.where(v[:m]>=cm,ar[:m],0))
        Y[i,1:]=ge*ar[1:]+cm
        pY[i,1:]=np.where(M[i,am]>=X[i,am],0,1)
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],X[n,m],Y[n,m]])); al=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: al.append((i,j)); ns=pM[i,j]; i-=1; j-=1; st=ns
        elif st==1: ns=pX[i,j]; i-=1; st=0 if ns==0 else (1 if ns==1 else 2)

            st2=0 if M[i,k]>=X[i,k] else 1
            j=k; st=st2
        if i<0 or j<0: break
    return dict(al)
